scope: Local exact import, build, discovery, rendered search and MCP verification. No publication, deployment, hosted verification or reader effectiveness claim.

pages.title: Show, sort, and filter a list

runtime.libraryBuild: Browser ESM bundle of the exact npm core, radio, and utils packages pinned in package-lock.json; built with esbuild
runtime.documentationNote: The browser demos use this pinned published runtime. Candidate documentation has separate provenance at /docs/manifest.json; match the installed version before combining them.

workerDryRun.command: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --dry-run --autoconfig=false --config test/tmp/step8-worker-dryrun.json --outdir test/tmp/step8-worker-bundle --metafile test/tmp/step8-worker-bundle/meta.json
workerDryRun.config: Same Worker entrypoint and compatibility settings; build hook, account and routes removed for a local compile of the already-built snapshot.
workerDryRun.note: Compilation and local Worker parity establish local loading. No hosted size-limit, deployment or production claim.

targetedTests.command: node --test test/docs.test.mjs test/import-docs.test.mjs test/agent-discovery.test.mjs test/agent-retrieval.test.mjs test/agent-setup.test.mjs test/development-docs.test.mjs test/mcp-sections.test.mjs test/mcp.test.mjs test/mcp-http.test.mjs

sourceRanking.note: The raw 38-page source corpus agrees with the consumer skill. Website ranking uses reading copies and includes additional diagnostic documents; identical ranked outputs across those different corpora are not claimed.

localHttp.scope: Direct HTTP reads of the built documentation. This does not establish search-engine indexing, browser WebMCP discovery, or model task success.

searchIncident.observed: Original built Pagefind entry JSON was zero bytes; browser returned 200 for it and reported JSON parse/metadata failure.
searchIncident.recovery: Ordinary rebuild produced valid 172-byte metadata and rendered search passed at both widths.
searchIncident.diagnosis: Selected tests use isolated temporary mutation fixtures; no selected test writes Pagefind output. Five isolated producer attempts each wrote 172 bytes before and after close. Producer cause was not reproduced or established.
searchIncident.safeguard: Build validates English indexed-page count at least matching imported pages and the referenced pf_meta is nonempty, after closing Pagefind. Valid/malformed/partial/empty fixtures run in isolated directories. This detects invalid build output and does not prove prevention of the original cause or subsequent file mutation.

reviewCorrections.source: Section index uses the snapshot documents’ existing complete Markdown directly. All 80 documents match; leading text and section-gap fixture proves offsets do not depend on reconstruction.
reviewCorrections.pagination: Section limit is 1–5, offset 0–5, total counts the canonical top-five set. Tests cover every one-result page, exhausted offsets and rejection beyond the schema cap. search_docs retains separate document pagination.
reviewCorrections.queryAcceptance: Removed the website tokenizer gate from section ranking. by, why and stopword-only query acceptance is checked against canonical ranking in the pure adapter and MCP.
reviewCorrections.searchGuard: Build and tests require the English page count to cover imported pages and a nonempty referenced pf_meta. Isolated valid and three negative fixtures pass.
